note: Crafts of The Descent/The Ascent (demonic_angelic axis). DESCENT is the demonic-pole craft of the Abyssal Choir — appetite, bargain, the honesty about hunger the pious lack; ASCENT is the angelic-pole craft of the Seraphic Orders — mercy, judgment, luminous certainty. Neither is 'evil' or 'good' in the flat sense: the Choir's honesty about want is a real virtue and the Orders' certainty is a real danger. The pure loci (The Maw, The Choir-Height) are cult-held. Authored by Aevi, SNG-054.

AND IT HEEDS THE END OF THE INTRODUCTION: at this rank you can call it off, and send it back to what it came from.
tree.cannot: Calling it off is a CHOICE you must make and it is not free — what you send back remembers being interrupted, and remembers you. Anyone else in the area is still struck ONE RUNG LOWER until you end it.

intensity.conserve: show it a small hunger
intensity.surge: show it everything and do not call it off — it eats until it is finished, and THE WIELDER IS STRUCK ONE RUNG LOWER if still present

bounds.text: IT IS NOT COMMANDED — you introduce, appetite decides
an appetite must be PRESENT to show
ANYONE ELSE IN THE AREA IS STRUCK ONE RUNG LOWER
what you fed remembers who does the showing

abilities.plainly: A fight action that introduces a hunger to a target and lets it feed. Rated 8 of 10 across a scope of 2. Limit: it is not commanded — appetite decides.
abilities.backlash: It looks at the person who showed it. You are the nearest appetite it has been introduced to, and it does not distinguish host from meal.
abilities.conserveSuppresses: show it a small hunger — small hungers finish and go

abilities.name: The Measured Sentence
abilities.narrationHints: The light weighs first and burns second. It is not wrath — the Orders are quite clear that it is not wrath — it is a measure taken and a sentence carried out in the same motion, from above, and the measure is accurate.
abilities.description: The Seraphic Orders' first offense: judgment as a physical event. What is found wanting is burned in proportion to the finding.
abilities.notFor: Mercy without measure (mercy is a SENTENCE here, it must be chosen aloud); the innocent — it will not burn what the measure clears, and it measures honestly whatever you wanted; hiding who did it; anything you have not actually judged.

tree.name: The Weighing Light
tree.grants: Judge one person in sight and let the sentence fall. Light comes down; what is found wanting burns, in proportion. ⚠ THE MEASURE IS HONEST — a target with little to answer for takes little, whatever you intended.
tree.cannot: IT MEASURES, THEN BURNS — you do not set the amount. A genuinely clean target takes nearly nothing and everyone watching sees that happen. You must actually pass judgment; a false one measures YOU.

tree.name: The Sentence Read
tree.grants: Judge a group. Each is measured separately and each takes their own weight — which is the Orders' entire point and is also horrible to watch.
tree.cannot: ⚠ IT MEASURES EVERYONE ELSE IN THE AREA TOO, at their own honest weight, one rung lower. There is no exempting anyone from a judgment.

tree.name: The Unfallen Light
tree.grants: The full sentence, unmitigated. Those with much to answer for do not survive being measured — the light strikes each in proportion to the weighing. AND YOU HOLD THE SCALE NOW: exempt whom you name from the weighing, and temper a sentence you have already begun.
tree.cannot: THE MEASURE IS STILL HONEST — you may exempt someone from being weighed, but you cannot make a heavy man light. Exempting the guilty is itself a judgment, and the Orders keep a record of who was spared and by whom.

intensity.conserve: weigh lightly — a warning, a mark
intensity.surge: weigh EVERYONE PRESENT INCLUDING YOURSELF, unmitigated, at their own honest weight — the Unfallen's own working

bounds.text: THE MEASURE IS HONEST — you do not set the amount
a clean target takes nearly nothing, publicly
EVERYONE ELSE PRESENT IS MEASURED at their own weight, one rung lower

abilities.plainly: A fight/social action that weighs a target and burns them in proportion. Rated 8 of 10 across a scope of 2. Limit: the measure is honest — you do not set the amount.
abilities.backlash: The judgment was false and the light knows. The sentence falls on the one who passed it, at their own honest weight.
abilities.conserveSuppresses: weigh lightly — a false light mark costs standing, not skin

abilities.name: The Sheltering Name
abilities.narrationHints: You put the name over someone else. Whatever the name is worth here, it is worth it for THEM now — and a person under a name that people credit is a person most of them will not touch.
abilities.description: The God-Named's keeping-craft, and the one that justifies the borrowing. A name you only ever use for yourself is a costume.
abilities.notFor: Protecting from anything that does not care about the name — beasts, weather, disease, the foreign, the checked; sheltering yourself; a name you have publicly failed with here.

tree.name: The Name Laid Over
tree.grants: Name a person as under your name's protection, aloud, in front of people. Those who credit it will not move against them — and often will not let others.
tree.cannot: Works only where the name is BELIEVED. It shelters from PEOPLE, not from the world. And it costs the name: shelter someone the crowd thinks unworthy and the name is thinner afterward.

tree.name: The Kept Household
tree.grants: Extend it to several, or to a place — a house, a wagon, a sickroom. It holds while you are away, on the strength of having been said.
tree.cannot: The wider it goes the thinner it is, and you are answerable for everyone under it. Someone sheltering under your name who does something ugly does it in your name.

tree.name: The Sanctuary Declared
tree.grants: A place placed under the name entirely. Armed men stop at the threshold and argue with each other about it rather than crossing.
tree.cannot: ⚠ YOU MUST BE ABLE TO STAND THERE AND MEAN IT. A declared sanctuary that fails is not merely a failure — it is the public unmaking of the name, and everyone inside it was relying on you.

intensity.conserve: name one person, quietly
intensity.surge: declare sanctuary; A DECLARED SANCTUARY THAT FAILS PUBLICLY UNMAKES THE NAME

bounds.text: works only where the name is BELIEVED
shelters from PEOPLE, not from the world
you are ANSWERABLE for everyone under it

abilities.plainly: A social/fight action that places your name's protection over someone else. Rated 5 of 10 across a scope of 2 for about a day.

abilities.name: The Borrowed Certainty
abilities.narrationHints: You speak as the name and people find they can do the thing. Not courage given — permission. Most people are waiting to be told it is allowed by someone entitled to say so.
abilities.description: The God-Named's lifting-craft. The borrowed authority pointed at a frightened room rather than at an enemy.
abilities.notFor: Granting skill they do not have; anyone who has checked the name; making the thing actually safe; using it twice on people who did it and it went badly.

tree.name: The Word Given
tree.grants: Tell people, as the name, that they can do this. A line holds that was breaking; a crew goes back into the water; someone says the thing they have not been able to say.
tree.cannot: They must CREDIT the name, and it grants PERMISSION, not ability — a frightened man who cannot swim still cannot swim. If it goes badly they will remember who told them.

tree.name: The Steady Company
tree.grants: Hold it over a group through a long hard stretch — a march, a siege watch, a night of triage.
tree.cannot: Holding it means being seen to be certain the entire time, including when you are not. That is the private cost and it does not show.

tree.name: The Named Cause
tree.grants: A community acts as one because the name says it is right. Harvests are saved this way, and so are stupid wars begun.
tree.cannot: ⚠ THE NAME IS BORROWED AND THE CONSEQUENCE IS YOURS. What a whole people does on your word is on your account, and the God-Named have a long institutional memory of the ones who got this wrong.

intensity.conserve: tell one person
intensity.surge: the named cause; WHAT A PEOPLE DOES ON YOUR WORD IS ON YOUR ACCOUNT

bounds.text: they must CREDIT the name
grants PERMISSION, not ability
if it goes badly they remember who told them

abilities.plainly: A social action that lets people act because the name says they may. Rated 5 of 10 across a scope of 3 for about twelve hours.

abilities.name: The Read Want
abilities.narrationHints: You see what someone actually wants, which is reliably not what they are asking for. The Bargainers' whole trade rests on this and they will tell you so without embarrassment.
abilities.description: Look at a person in conversation and see the want beneath the request — the man asking for money who wants to be taken seriously, the one asking for justice who wants an apology. The Bargainers' first craft: read the want before naming the price.
abilities.notFor: Reading anything but WANT (not plans, not lies, not history); people who genuinely want nothing; using it without their knowing you can — Bargainers announce it.

tree.name: The Want Under It
tree.grants: Look at a person in conversation and see the want beneath the request — the man asking for money who wants to be taken seriously, the one asking for justice who wants an apology.
tree.cannot: It reads WANT and nothing else. The self-deceived read as they believe themselves, which is often the useful thing anyway. Someone who wants nothing gives you nothing.

tree.name: The Table Read
tree.grants: Read a room of them, or read one deeply enough to see which want they would trade the others for.
tree.cannot: Knowing the want does not tell you what it is WORTH to them, and the two are different numbers. A wrong guess at price after a right read of want is the classic Bargainer failure.

tree.name: The Whole Appetite
tree.grants: A person's wants entire and in order, including the ones they have never said out loud and the one they would be ruined by getting.
tree.cannot: ⚠ YOU NOW KNOW SOMETHING ABOUT THEM THEY DO NOT KNOW, and the Bargainers' own rule is that you name what you read before you trade on it. Trading on an unannounced read is the thing that gets a Bargainer refused at every table in the foothills.

intensity.conserve: read the surface want
intensity.surge: the whole appetite; NAME WHAT YOU READ BEFORE YOU TRADE ON IT

bounds.text: reads WANT and nothing else
the self-deceived read as they BELIEVE themselves
knowing the want does not tell you the PRICE

abilities.plainly: A social/puzzle action that reads what someone actually wants. Rated 6 of 10 on one target for about three hours.
abilities._descriptionWas: The Bargainers' first craft: read the want before naming the price, because a price against the wrong want is an insult.

abilities.name: The Honest Price
abilities.narrationHints: You name what a thing will truly cost — to you, to them, to whoever is not in the room — and having named it, you can deliver it exactly. No trick is the trick. The Bargainers are trusted in the foothills because they are.
abilities.description: State the full cost of a thing aloud, including the parts everyone was politely not mentioning — and having named it, deliver it exactly. Deals close that were stuck, or die honestly. The Bargainers' making-craft, and the reason anyone sits at their table twice.
abilities.notFor: Naming a price you cannot deliver; softening a price to close a deal (that is the one unforgivable thing); pricing what is not yours; forcing agreement.

tree.name: The Price Named
tree.grants: State the full cost of a thing aloud, including the parts everyone was politely not mentioning. Deals close that were stuck, or die honestly instead of curdling for a season.
tree.cannot: It must be THE TRUE PRICE. Understate it to close and the craft fails publicly and permanently for you. It does not make anyone AGREE — it makes agreement possible.

tree.name: The Kept Terms
tree.grants: Structure a real exchange between parties who do not trust each other, and hold it — both sides can verify the terms are what was said.
tree.cannot: You are now a party to it, and a broken term is broken against you as well. Bargainers spend real years repairing this.

tree.name: The Standing Table
tree.grants: A place where terms can be made at all — a neutral table between feuding houses, a market where a stranger's word is worth something.
tree.cannot: ⚠ THE TABLE IS ONLY WORTH WHAT YOU ARE. It rests entirely on your record; one softened price in your history and the whole thing is furniture. The foothills remember.

intensity.conserve: price one small thing
intensity.surge: the standing table; IT IS ONLY WORTH WHAT YOU ARE

bounds.text: it must be THE TRUE PRICE — understating it fails publicly and permanently
it makes agreement POSSIBLE; it does not compel it
you become a party to what you structure

abilities.plainly: A social/puzzle action that names a thing's true cost so a deal can be made. Rated 5 of 10 across a scope of 2 for about two days.
abilities._descriptionWas: The Bargainers' making-craft, and the reason anyone sits at their table twice.

abilities.name: The Weighed Word
abilities.narrationHints: You ask, and the light answers for them. Not mind-reading — WEIGHING. A person under it can refuse to speak, and their silence is itself weighed, and everyone sees the scale move.
abilities.description: The Seraphic Orders' first craft, and the reason their testimony is accepted where nobody's word is.
abilities.notFor: Compelling an answer (silence is permitted, and is itself an answer); reading thoughts; weighing what someone sincerely believes but is wrong about — it reads HONESTY, never accuracy; using it on someone who has not been told it is running.

tree.name: The Question Weighed
tree.grants: Ask a question aloud with the light on it, and everyone present — you included — SEES whether the answer given was honest. Not what is true: whether they believe it.
tree.cannot: It reads HONESTY, NOT ACCURACY. A sincere fool weighs clean. Silence is allowed and reads as silence. ⚠ And the Orders require you to announce it before asking — an unannounced weighing is the thing that gets an Order-bearer stripped.

tree.name: The Weighed Room
tree.grants: Several people, or a matter run through to the end — a dispute, an accusation, a claim of ownership, with each answer weighed in front of everyone.
tree.cannot: You have made a public record and it cuts both ways: the person you were defending is weighed too, on every question.

tree.name: The Assize
tree.grants: A whole matter weighed — a killing, a fraud, a betrayal — with every party answering under the light and the community watching the scale.
tree.cannot: ⚠ IT WILL FIND SOMETHING NOBODY WAS LOOKING FOR. An assize that begins as a theft ends as a marriage undone, and the Orders hold you responsible for having opened it.

intensity.conserve: weigh one question
intensity.surge: the assize; IT WILL FIND SOMETHING NOBODY WAS LOOKING FOR

bounds.text: reads HONESTY, never ACCURACY — a sincere fool weighs clean
silence is PERMITTED and reads as silence
you must ANNOUNCE it before asking

abilities.plainly: A social/puzzle action that shows publicly whether an answer was honest. Rated 6 of 10 across a scope of 2 for about three hours.

abilities.name: The Shielding Light
abilities.narrationHints: Light between a person and what is coming for them. Not a wall — a place harm will not go, held by someone standing in it and willing to take what it turns aside.
abilities.description: The Seraphic Orders' interposing-craft. The Order-bearer is the shield; the light is only where they put it.
abilities.notFor: Shielding yourself; stopping what is already landed; holding it while doing anything else; protecting someone the light will not cover — ⛔ it will not shield a person from a consequence they have earned.

tree.name: The Light Interposed
tree.grants: Put the light between one person and one source of harm. Blows, fire, falling stone and hostile workings turn aside from them while you hold it.
tree.cannot: ⛔ NOT YOURSELF — the craft interposes for ANOTHER, always. You can do nothing else while it holds. And it turns harm aside; it does not undo what already landed.

tree.name: The Held Ground
tree.grants: Several people, or one held through a sustained assault — a doorway, a wounded line, a family in a burning house.
tree.cannot: The wider it goes the thinner, and ⚠ WHAT IT TURNS ASIDE GOES SOMEWHERE — usually into you, and the Orders consider that the correct destination.

tree.name: The Standing Light
tree.grants: A place harm does not enter while an Order-bearer stands in it. Sieges have broken on one of these.
tree.cannot: ⚠ IT ENDS WHEN YOU DO. Everyone behind it is relying on a single person remaining upright, and the Unfallen would tell you that is the proper shape of faith. The Orders' honours, like the March's, are mostly posthumous.

intensity.conserve: interpose briefly for one
intensity.surge: the standing light; IT ENDS WHEN YOU DO

bounds.text: ⛔ NOT YOURSELF — it interposes for ANOTHER
you can do nothing else while it holds
WHAT IT TURNS ASIDE GOES SOMEWHERE — usually into you
it will not shield a person from a consequence they have earned

abilities.plainly: A fight/social action that turns harm aside from someone else while you hold it. Rated 6 of 10 across a scope of 2 for about four hours.

abilities.name: The Read Hunger
abilities.narrationHints: Everything that eats has a shape to its eating. You read it — what this thing wants, how badly, what it will cross to get it, and what it will not.
abilities.description: The Abyssal Choir's first craft, and the reason they survive down there. You do not negotiate with an appetite you have not read.
abilities.notFor: Reading thought, plan, or loyalty (only APPETITE); the genuinely sated; changing anything; anything with no want at all — a machine, a corpse, a Stopped thing.

tree.name: The Shape of Its Eating
tree.grants: Read one creature, person, or thing-that-wants and the craft NAMES it: what it hungers for, how strongly, what it will risk, and the one thing it will not do even hungry.
tree.cannot: APPETITE ONLY — it tells you nothing about plans, loyalties or what it knows. The truly sated read as empty and are the most dangerous thing in the room for exactly that reason.

tree.name: The Fed and the Starving
tree.grants: Read a group or a place — which of them is hungriest, which is nearly full, and where in a warren the eating happens.
tree.cannot: Reading a room of appetites is nauseating and it lingers. And knowing what a thing wants is not knowing you can supply it.

tree.name: The Great Appetite
tree.grants: Something large — a deep thing, a host, a place's whole hunger — read entire, including the want under the want.
tree.cannot: ⚠ IT NOTICES BEING READ AT THIS DEPTH. You have introduced yourself, and the Devouring find being understood almost as satisfying as being fed.

intensity.conserve: read one appetite
intensity.surge: the great appetite; IT NOTICES BEING READ AT THIS DEPTH

bounds.text: APPETITE ONLY — no plans, loyalties or knowledge
the truly SATED read as empty
knowing the want is not being able to supply it

abilities.plainly: A puzzle/social action that names what a thing hungers for and what it will risk. Rated 5 of 10 across a scope of 2 for about three hours.

abilities.name: The Offered Lesser
abilities.narrationHints: You give a hunger something smaller to eat. Not banishment, not command — SUBSTITUTION, and it is the most useful thing the Choir knows, because a fed thing goes away.
abilities.description: The Abyssal Choir's turning-craft. Everything down there wants something; almost nothing insists on wanting THIS.
abilities.notFor: Refusing to pay (something is eaten, always, and you choose what); substituting a person without their consent — ⛔ the Choir's one hard law; anything whose want is specific to this target; getting the offering back.

tree.name: The Lesser Given
tree.grants: Offer a hunger a substitute it will accept — livestock, a stored thing, blood freely given, a name, a memory. It takes that instead and disengages.
tree.cannot: SOMETHING IS EATEN. The offering is gone and it must be genuinely wanted — a token it does not want insults it and makes things worse. ⛔ Never a person who has not agreed.

tree.name: The Standing Offering
tree.grants: Set a substitution that keeps — a place regularly fed, so what lives near it does not take what you care about.
tree.cannot: ⚠ A STANDING OFFERING IS A RELATIONSHIP, and it grows. What you feed gets larger and its want gets more specific over time.

tree.name: The Turned Appetite
tree.grants: Redirect a large hunger entirely — off a village, off a road, off a person it had fixed on.
tree.cannot: ⚠ IT GOES SOMEWHERE. You have not reduced the eating; you have moved it, and the Choir requires you to know where and say so. Turning a thing onto a place you have not warned is the other unforgivable one.

intensity.conserve: a small offering, a short turning
intensity.surge: turn a great appetite; IT GOES SOMEWHERE, and you must know where and say so

bounds.text: SOMETHING IS EATEN — the offering is genuinely gone
⛔ never a person who has not agreed
the substitute must be GENUINELY WANTED
a standing offering GROWS
